summary: Okay #ncte19 my lunch break is over, grabbed some great sessions. Back to work, see you on my next short break. Thank you to presenters who share their conference materials openly for those of us who can not make the event.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Okay #ncte19 my lunch break is over, grabbed some great sessions. Back to work, see you on my next short break. Thank you to presenters who share their conference materials openly for those of us who can not make the event.
